description:
Mirror and Control your Phone


This is a major maintenance refresh of Vysor runtime to enabled continued development of the web/electron apps:
Vue 2 → Vue 3
Update electron
Linux and Windows no longer requires the Vysor iOS application for mirroring
iOS mirroring and control now requires iOS 27
iOS control now uses a different mouse input mechanism that resolves all performance/accuracy issues. Dongle is no longer necessary.
iOS now supports wireless mirroring
iOS now supports Vysor Share
Mirrored devices now expose an MCP for AI viewing and control.
